rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an effect or result, especially when discussing what an action means for people or the environment.

example.english: This decision could have a major implication for the lives of nearby residents.
example.traditional: 呢個決定可能會對附近居民嘅生活造成好大影響。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 wui5 deoi3 fu6 gan6 geoi1 man4 ge3 saang1 wut6 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this instead of 影響 when focusing on the resulting consequences, usually serious or negative ones.

example.english: If they do not stop, the implication will be very serious.
example.traditional: 如果再唔收手，後果會好嚴重。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 m4 sau1 sau2 hau6 gwo2 wui5 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this for a meaning that is understood from someone's words but not stated directly.

example.english: The implication of what he said was that someone was always late.
example.traditional: 佢話大家都應該準時，言外之意係有人成日遲到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jing1 goi1 zeon2 si4 jin4 ngoi6 zi1 ji3 hai6 jau5 jan4 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3
